products.title: Homlux Home Office Desk Chair
products.description: The HOMLUX Home Office Desk Chair is an ergonomic, armless office chair designed for comfort and space-saving. It features an adjustable seat height ranging from 19.7" to 22.8" and a smooth 360° swivel for effortless mobility. The chair is constructed with a rock-solid metal base capable of supporting up to 264 lbs, a sculpted multilayer bentwood backrest, and a 3" thick PU cushion for all-day support. Its compact design allows it to tuck neatly under desks, making it ideal for home offices or tight workstations. It is available in sleek black or crisp white finishes.

products.title: Brown Leather Adjustable Swivel Computer Office Chair
products.description: The Kamau Office Chair by Acme Furniture is a sophisticated addition to any home office, featuring a high backrest and rich Vintage Cocoa top grain leather upholstery. Designed for comfort and functionality, it includes a 360-degree swivel seat, adjustable height settings, and a durable metal 5-star base. The chair's aesthetic is enhanced by patchwork aluminum armrests with elegant nail-head trim, blending transitional style with modern utility.
